```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidytuesdayR)
library(janitor)
library(ggeasy)
library(Manu)


# choosing a dataset randomly

set.seed(4)
ttyears <- c(2018:2025)
ttweeks <- c(1:52)

# choose a year at random
chosen_year <- sample(ttyears, size = 1)

# choose at week at random
chosen_week <- sample(ttweeks, size = 1)

# read the data from that year/week

df <- tidytuesdayR::tt_load(chosen_year, chosen_week)

# print dataset
print(df)

palm <- df[[1]]


```


The data for this plot comes from a `r chosen_year` TidyTuesday challenge. The Week `r chosen_week` data that year was about Palm Trees.
